1018-2225-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1018-2225-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.libraryCardState: in the top two cards of your library

2232-3908-4753-8327.easyPrerequisites: You are able to activate one of Feroz's loyalty abilities this turn.
2232-3908-4753-8327.description:
Activate Feroz's second loyalty ability by putting zero loyalty counters on it, causing you to draw a card and put Clever Impersonator from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Feroz.
Put Feroz into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Clever Impersonator enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers. Choose to return Spark Double to your hand if it's on the battlefield, or nothing to your hand otherwise.
Activate Clever Impersonator's second ability by putting zero loyalty counters on it, causing you to draw a card and put Spark Double from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Clever Impersonator, thus making it a copy of Feroz that isn't legendary.
When Spark Double enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Clever Impersonator from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Spark Double's second ability by putting zero loyalty counters on it, causing you to draw a card and put Clever Impersonator from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to have Clever Impersonator enter as a copy of Spark Double, thus making it a copy of Feroz that isn't legendary.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3384-4550-5567-8249--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3384-4550-5567-8249--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

579-3995-6006.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
579-3995-6006.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}{U} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-5086-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-728-4742-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-4742-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1368-6006-6321-6791.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6006-6321-6791.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

3259-3756-6628--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3259-3756-6628--85--106.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4976-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2034-4976-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Open the Graves and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3490-3755-6965-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-6965-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2084-7063.description:
Cast Ember Island Production by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1309-2792-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1309-2792-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Great Whale
When Salvager of Secrets and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
1309-2792-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

3090-6848-6849.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to proliferate or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite after an opponent gains control of it.
3090-6848-6849.description:
Donate control of Bloodcrazed Hoplite to an opponent.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite either by proliferating or by any other method.
Bloodcrazed Hoplite triggers, targeting any creature controlled by you or another opponent.
When the opponent commits that crime, Patrolling Peacemaker triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-955-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-955-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-2438-3497-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4112-6281.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to discard Sharuum.
4112-6281.description:
Discard Sharuum in any way. Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a token copy of Sharuum that is a 4/4 black Zombie.
When the Sharuum token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put the nontoken Sharuum into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The nontoken Sharuum's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

654-880-6529.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-6529.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1174-1479-5671.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-5671.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

586-2393-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Sifter of Skulls and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

147-5788.description:
Cast Starfall Invocation by paying {3}{W}{W}, choosing to promise an opponent a gift.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Starfall Invocation.
Resolve Starfall Invocation, causing an opponent to draw a card, then destroying all creatures and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1799-2034-2455-5359.description:
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1361-1651-3340-4321.description:
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, creating a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Treasure, untapping Ancient Den.
Repeat.

2677-3862.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Flumph indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Flumph.
2677-3862.description:
Give Flumph indestructible, if needed.
Deal damage to Flumph.
Flumph triggers, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, dealing 1 damage to Flumph and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 3.

3050-5256.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{W}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3050-5256.description:
Cast Kroxa and Kunoros either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{R}{W}{B} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Kroxa and Kunoros enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kroxa and Kunoros, causing you to mill cards equal to Kroxa and Kunoros' power.
Resolve the Kroxa and Kunoros trigger, causing you to exile five other cards from your graveyard and return Kroxa and Kunoros from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2390-3372-5292.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to place a counter on a permanent or player.
2390-3372-5292.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing All Will Be One to become an enchantment creature.
Place a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Voice of the Blessed triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-779-3550-4269.description:
Cast Flame Jab from your graveyard by paying {R} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Birgi and Moonveil Regent trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Moonveil Regent trigger, causing you to discard your hand, mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Flame Jab, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1275-1517-4872.notablePrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture has two lore counters on it.
1275-1517-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chisei triggers, removing a lore counter from The Mirari Conjecture.
After your draw step, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, returning Time Warp to your hand.
Repeat.
